headline: EPS rebounds sequentially but trails last year
summary_short: The Nisshin OilliO Group reported Q2 FY2026 basic EPS of ¥37.59, down 78.1% y/y from ¥171.67.
summary_long: Basic EPS of ¥37.59 fell 78.1% year-over-year from ¥171.67, though it rebounded 124.4% sequentially from ¥16.75 in the prior quarter. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
